title: Hearty Fermented Spanish Porcini Cocido Madrileno
description: A creamy and fermented Spanish dish featuring porcini, served with toast, this gluten-free-friendly cocido madrileno is a quick fix for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Soak the dried porcini mushrooms in 2 cups of hot water for 20 minutes
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant
Add the Spanish chorizo and cook until browned
Add the chickpeas, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Add the soaked porcini mushrooms and their liquid, and the chicken broth, and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
Slice the gluten-free bread into thick slices and toast until crispy
Serve the cocido madrileno in a lazy susan spinner, with the toasted bread on the side
Let each guest serve themselves and spin the lazy susan to share
